notes.title: 'Home Safety Hotline: Seasonal Worker' DLC NOW AVAILABLE! ❄️
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1B08V9NPdrg;full][/previewyoutube]
Attention Employees!

The wait is now over! Home Safety Hotline's new holly jolly DLC is [b]NOW AVAILABLE ON PC & CONSOLES[/b]! ☎️❄️
[h3]
[b]GET IT NOW![/b] ⬇️⬇️[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2914730/Home_Safety_Hotline_Seasonal_Worker

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new 4-day storyline set during the holiday season.
[*]28 new horrifying entries to discover, featuring the art of [b]Trevor Henderson[/b], [b]Eduardo Valdés-Hevia[/b], [b]Lou-Ellen Allwood[/b], and [b]Omega Black[/b].
[*]Meet new fully voice acted characters and callers, featuring the talents of [b]Longmont Potion Castle[/b], [b]Granny[/b],[b] Mo Mo O'Brien[/b] and more!
[*]Live to attend the annual office Christmas Party.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807623/40e41c0fa9f13bcedec685e1e9b48c50c1792915.png[/img]

[h1]Translations Coming Soon![/h1]

Another highly requested update is incoming! We're happy to say that a [b]Localization Update[/b] will be on the way next, as our friends over at [b]Puppet Combo[/b] have worked hard translating the game into[b] 6 NEW languages[/b], including French, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian and Spanish! We're working on getting these migrated over to the PC build soon!

notes.title: Call Trainer Update (Version 2.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807623/248bf692a1d17dd05540b8b0ef27004d97237d92.png[/img]

Hello again, employees! We've heard your many requests for more playable post-game content, and after a lot of brainstorming, we came up with a new unlockable game mode that we think will satisfy that desire!

[h1]"Call Trainer" Mode[/h1]

[b]"Call Trainer"[/b] is a new [b]endless score-based game mode[/b] that unlocks after you finish the main story mode! 

In this training software made for bettering the timing and accuracy of HSH Responders, you will answer a series of [b]random calls[/b] and be tasked with correctly answering as many calls as possible before failing. Multiple correct answers in a row will net you[b] combos[/b] to increase your score!

But be warned- these calls are[b] timed[/b], and as you progress your alloted time to answer each call will steadily decrease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807623/5af6125a7903295672b8bd80ec17c6b81eab4be6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807623/60aab547d908b3cb2a0c2999f7d7dc492b9cd328.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our Next Game: Please Insert Disc[/h1]

Meanwhile, we just launched the store page for Night Signal Entertainment's next horror game - [b]Please Insert Disc![/b] 

Please Insert Disc is a puzzle horror game about navigating the underbelly of a 2000's era gaming console in an attempt to restore its functionality, but you may awaken something else in the process.

Check out the store page, and if it sounds interesting, [b]be sure to add it to your Wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2855360/Please_Insert_Disc/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807623/f25e51f40fc2739adac1905053e7b7603ad2f1a0.png[/img]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update (v1.1)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807623/fa483f9220d85fa29299b925264a5a406879f93e.gif[/img]

Hello employees. Thank you all for an amazing launch week! We've recently tackled some of the more common issues that have been reported, and have additionally added some new options to assist in 100% replays or for those who just want to see what will happen if they fail. Full change list below!

[h1]QOL Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Jr. Supervisor Options[/b]: These are new toggles that will appear in the Options Menu after successfully finishing the game to assist with replays. These include:

[list]
[*] [b]Unemployment Immunity:[/b] Makes it impossible to be fired to make exploring Consequence Calls more convenient on replays.
[*] [b]Always Display Accuracy:[/b] Displays a live current accuracy level for the day in the upper right corner of the menu.
[*] [b]Skip Call Wait Period: [/b]Adds a button to the call window that allows players to skip the waiting period and get right to the next call.
[/list]
[*] [b]Weekly Report:[/b] After finishing the game, a new application on the desktop will appear that will display every caller in the game and whether you correctly deduced their problem or not. (NOTE: All callers from Day 7 will appear as incorrect due to a saving oversight before this patch went out.)
[/list]
[h1]Fixes & Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] "Bed Bug" image replaced for accuracy.
[*] Fix for some machines not being able to display in-game videos properly.
[*] Fixed typos in numerous entries.
[*] Fixed typo in ending credits.
[*] Fixed Day 7 callers not being saved after completion of Day 7.
[*] Reworded Delete Application to be more accurate. (The application does not delete your entire save, but rather simply resets your weekly progress. Post-game unlocks will remain unlocked.)
[/list]

Thank you for all the reports, and for the incredibly kind reviews thus far! We're currently still investigating some trickier bug reports but we wanted to be sure y'all had access to these fixes sooner rather than later! We also may or may not be cooking up a commonly requested game mode... stay tuned, employees!
